mods.name: Multi Respawn Selector
mods.description: Keeps multiple player respawn points and lets players choose one before respawning.

releases.notes:
# Multi Respawn Selector v1.0.0

Initial release for Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.1 + Fabric.

## Features

- Save multiple respawn points per player.
- Supports beds, respawn anchors, and command-added respawn points.
- Choose a saved respawn point after death.
- Server-side validation before respawning.
- Automatically removes invalid beds and respawn anchors.
- Supports cross-dimension respawning.
- Respawn anchors consume only 1 charge per successful respawn.
- Sneak + right-click saved beds or respawn anchors to rename them.
- Includes `/multirespawn` management commands.
- Persistent data across server restarts.
- English and Simplified Chinese localization.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Java 17 or newer

Install this mod on both client and server.

## Commands

- `/multirespawn add <name>`
- `/multirespawn list`
- `/multirespawn remove <id_or_name>`
- `/multirespawn rename <id_or_name> <new_name>`
- `/multirespawn clear`

## Notes

This is the first public release. Please report bugs with reproduction steps, Minecraft version, Fabric Loader version, Fabric API version, and logs if available.

readmeSummary: Multi Respawn Selector is a Fabric mod for Minecraft Java Edition 1.20.1. It lets each player keep multiple respawn points instead of being limited to the last bed or respawn anchor they used.
